name: The Horned King's Might
summary: Strength +2 (max 24). The price: half damage to the Horned King and his, and a DC 19 Wisdom save before you may target him or Kehlenn.

source.note: chapter 24: the Horned King's bargain, with only the benefits the hero chooses; the Price is the cost. Our words.

benefit.text: You asked for more, and he gave it. Your Strength score increases by 2, to a maximum of 24.

cost.text: The Price. Only a Wish or Divine Intervention can lift it.

features.name: The Price
features.summary: Half damage against the Horned King and his minions; a DC 19 Wisdom save to target him, Kehlenn, the tree or their minions, or you lose the action (the engine hook waits).
features.text: You deal half damage to the Horned King and his minions, and before you attack or cast at him, the Crooked Queen, the Crooked Tree or their minions you make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or pick another target or lose the action.
